description: This PHP source file implements a web page for configuring SIP global parameters such as interface binding, IP address family, and SIP client control (start/stop). It includes HTML for the form, embedded JavaScript for dynamic behavior and AJAX interactions, and PHP code to retrieve current configuration values.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves current SIP global parameter settings such as interface name, IP address family, line registration status, and SIP process status.
